scripts.prebuild: mkdir -p public/js public/css && cp -r js/* public/js/ && cp -r css/* public/css/
scripts.build: npm run prebuild && tsc && vite build
scripts.postbuild: cp dist/js/contact-cards-bundle.js js/contact-cards-bundle.js && cp dist/js/contact-cards-bundle.js public/js/contact-cards-bundle.js && cp dist/css/contact-cards-bundle.css css/contact-cards-bundle.css && cp dist/css/contact-cards-bundle.css public/css/contact-cards-bundle.css
